text:
samir_sales: Heads-up — Sable.ai just asked us to pin Sable-3 (v3.0.1) to eu-west-1 for an 8-week pilot. Must provide an int8 quantized variant, dedicated EU pool, and strict EU data residency. They said they're willing to sign a short reserved-capacity contract.
megan_product: got it. can you confirm license and timeline + perf expectations (qps / latency)?
samir_sales: license = Apache-2 (PDF attached). pilot start ~3w. expected steady 25-50 QPS, spikes to ~150. 99p latency target ~250ms (prompt->first-token). cost sensitivity: they insist on int8.
liz_onboard: adding legal + export-control check. need weights hash + vendor attestation and any data-usage restrictions. tell them to upload the attestation to the intake form.
ben_infra: back-of-envelope: eu-west-1 can support ~50 qps on a single vibra-pool (4x A10G equiv) for fp16. int8 could reduce instance/memory needs. we need to verify kernel support for Sable-3 int8 on our runtime. also propose a local eu fallback policy (stay in eu-west-1 but degraded capacity) if reserved pool saturates.
samir_sales: customer rejects cross-border fallback for pilot. Any fallback must remain inside eu-west-1 (e.g., limit QPS, scale to smaller instances, or deny extra traffic).
megan_product: scope for intake (proposal): 1) catalog entry for v3.0.1 + sable-3-int8 variant, 2) reserve dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for pilot window, 3) require legal attestation + weights checksum, 4) perf evaluation on customer-supplied anonymized prompts, 5) rollout + rollback plan, 6) monitoring & escalation contact. owner: @megan_product. priority P1 (pilot).
megan_product: high-level acceptance criteria:
- AC1: artifact verification & legal/export-control signoff
- AC2: sable-3-int8 quality delta <= 3% against fp16 on customer test set
- AC3: 99th pct latency <= 250ms at steady 50 QPS in the dedicated pool
- AC4: reserved capacity and billing term agreed
- AC5: catalog pinning rule ensures v3.0.1 is used for pilot traffic
ben_infra: I'll confirm runtime kernel + quant paths by EOD Wed. If kernels missing, eng-runtime will need a small integration ticket. Fallback plan: reduce concurrency, switch to single-token streaming under overload.
liz_onboard: I'll start legal verification and export-control. requirement: vendor attestation + SHA256(weight file) + explicit licensing doc. ask customer to provide the anonymized sample prompt set for eval.
deploy-bot: CI: catalog-entry-validator started for candidate sable-3-int8 (CI-6218)
qa_bot: reminder: add a canary eval against customer prompts and a synthetic perf run in staging before pilot. Also capture prompt latencies and token counts. :eyes:
samir_sales: I'll push Sable to upload attestation + prompt set today and share their contact for billing. negotiating the reserved terms now.
megan_product: I'll open intake ticket PROD-1298 and link this thread. tentative checklist will be in the ticket: catalog entry, quant build, legal signoff, perf eval, pool reservation, rollout plan, monitoring thresholds, customer escalation.
samir_sales: thanks — I'll update here once Sable uploads the files. :white_check_mark:
